name: Color palette & contrast checker
description: Check WCAG 2.1 AA and AAA accessibility contrast ratios between foreground and background colors, and convert between Hex and RGB.

seo.metaTitle: Color palette & contrast checker — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Check WCAG 2.1 AA and AAA accessibility contrast ratios between foreground and background colors, and convert between Hex and RGB. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/image/color-contrast-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Color palette & contrast checker processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/image/color-contrast-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does Color palette & contrast checker upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Color palette & contrast checker executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/image/color-contrast-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Color palette & contrast checker?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/color_contrast.json or open /tools/color-contrast?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
